// Volatility-Compression Release Coil Model
// ATR: Wilder RMA via atr() — validated vs TradingView
// Predictability: efficiency ratio abs(net)/sum(abs(one-bar moves))

atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 2, 60, 1)
coilLookback = input(100, "Coil Lookback", 20, 200, 1)
rangeLookback = input(100, "Range Lookback", 20, 200, 1)
vovLen = input(20, "Vol-of-Vol Length", 5, 60, 1)
predictLen = input(20, "Predictability Length", 5, 60, 1)
coilThreshold = input(70, "Coil Threshold", 50, 95, 1)
releaseMult = input(1.5, "Release Multiplier", 1.1, 3.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

tr1 = high - low
tr2 = abs(high - close[1])
tr3 = abs(low - close[1])
tr = max(tr1, max(tr2, tr3))
atrVal = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)
rng = high - low
highestAtr = highest(atrVal, coilLookback)
lowestAtr = lowest(atrVal, coilLookback)
atrDen = max(highestAtr - lowestAtr, 0.000000001)
atrPos = (highestAtr - atrVal) / atrDen
highestRng = highest(rng, rangeLookback)
lowestRng = lowest(rng, rangeLookback)
rngDen = max(highestRng - lowestRng, 0.000000001)
rangePos = (highestRng - rng) / rngDen
coilLoad = 100 * (atrPos + rangePos) / 2
atrGuard = max(atrVal, 0.000000001)
vovRaw = stdev(atrVal, vovLen)
vov = vovRaw / atrGuard
vovPrev = vov[1]
volRising = vov > vovPrev
netMove = abs(close - close[predictLen])
sumChg = 0.0
ii = 0
while ii < predictLen {
  sumChg = sumChg + abs(close[ii] - close[ii + 1])
  ii = ii + 1
}
predictability = netMove / max(sumChg, 0.000000001)
predScaled = 100 * predictability
releaseExp = rng > releaseMult * lowestRng
hhLine = highest(high, rangeLookback)
hhPrev = hhLine[1]
llLine = lowest(low, rangeLookback)
llPrev = llLine[1]
armed = coilLoad > coilThreshold and volRising
buyCond = armed and releaseExp and close > hhPrev
sellCond = armed and releaseExp and close < llPrev
buyPrev = buyCond[1]
sellPrev = sellCond[1]
buySig = buyCond and not buyPrev
sellSig = sellCond and not sellPrev

if armed {
  bgcolor("#1a2333")
}
if buySig {
  bgcolor("#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
  bgcolor("#ff4477")
}
if buySig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy Release", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell Release", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if buySig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy Release", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 0, "separate")
}
if sellSig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell Release", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 0, "separate")
}

plot(coilLoad, "Coil Load", "#22aaff", 2, "separate")
plot(predScaled, "Predictability", "#ffd43b", 1, "separate")
hline(coilThreshold, "#ffd43b", "separate")
plot3d(coilLoad, "Coil Load Tower", "surface", "#22aaff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(predScaled, "Predictability Solidity", "ribbon", "#ffd43b", "separate", 1)

sessStart = input(0, "Session Start Hour", 0, 23, 1)
sessLen = input(20, "Session Length Bars", 10, 100, 1)
structLen = input(20, "Structure Lookback 1h", 5, 100, 1)
bufTicks = input(2, "Breakout Buffer Ticks", 0, 20, 1)
stopTicks = input(30, "Hard Stop Ticks", 5, 200, 1)
minQ = input(60, "Min Structure Quality", 0, 100, 1)

sessHigh = highest(high, sessLen)
sessLow = lowest(low, sessLen)
h1Hsrc = security("1h", high)
h1Lsrc = security("1h", low)
h1C = security("1h", close)
h1High = highest(h1Hsrc, structLen)
h1Low = lowest(h1Lsrc, structLen)
h1Mid = (h1High + h1Low) / 2
h1Range = h1High - h1Low
h1RangePrev = h1Range[1]
h1CPrev = h1C[1]
expand = h1Range > h1RangePrev
topQ = h1High - h1Range * 0.25
botQ = h1Low + h1Range * 0.25
extreme = h1C > topQ or h1C < botQ
quality = 50 + (expand ? 25 : 0) + (extreme ? 25 : 0)
conf = quality / 100
bull = h1C > h1Mid and h1C > h1CPrev
bear = h1C < h1Mid and h1C < h1CPrev
bufDist = bufTicks * 0.1 + sessStart * 0.0
stopDist = stopTicks * 0.1
longLvl = sessHigh + bufDist
shortLvl = sessLow - bufDist
buySig = crossover(close, longLvl) and bull and quality >= minQ
sellSig = crossunder(close, shortLvl) and bear and quality >= minQ

var entryPx = 0.0
var stopLvl = 0.0
var inLong = 0.0
var inShort = 0.0

longStopHit = inLong == 1 and low < stopLvl
shortStopHit = inShort == 1 and high > stopLvl

if buySig {
    model.confidence(conf)
    model.stopLoss(stopDist, "abs")
    model.longEntry("siege")
    entryPx := close
    stopLvl := close - stopDist
    inLong := 1
    inShort := 0
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
    model.confidence(conf)
    model.stopLoss(stopDist, "abs")
    model.shortEntry("siege")
    entryPx := close
    stopLvl := close + stopDist
    inShort := 1
    inLong := 0
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if longStopHit {
    model.longExit("siege")
    inLong := 0
    stopLvl := close
    entryPx := close
}
if shortStopHit {
    model.shortExit("siege")
    inShort := 0
    stopLvl := close
    entryPx := close
}
if inLong == 0 and inShort == 0 and not buySig and not sellSig {
    stopLvl := close
    entryPx := close
}

plot(sessHigh, "Session High", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot(sessLow, "Session Low", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")
plot(stopLvl, "Hard Stop", "#ffaa00", 1, "stepline")

flowBase = input(50, "Flow Base", 0, 100, 1)
critical_threshold = input(150, "Critical Threshold", 100, 200, 1)
spin_factor = input(1.0, "Spin Factor", 0.1, 3.0, 0.1)
ring_count = input(3, "Ring Count", 1, 5, 1)
ring_expansion_rate = input(2.0, "Ring Expansion Rate", 0.5, 5.0, 0.1)
ring_max_radius = input(10.0, "Ring Max Radius", 5.0, 20.0, 0.5)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

flow_psi = close + flowBase
spinVel = spin_factor * flow_psi
perimR = 2.0
spanR = ring_max_radius - perimR
discAngleModRaw = bar_index * spinVel / 360.0
discAngleMod = discAngleModRaw - floor(discAngleModRaw / 360.0) * 360.0
overState = flow_psi > critical_threshold
shockEnv = overState and spanR > 0
ringSpan1 = perimR + spanR * 0.15
ringSpan2 = perimR + spanR * 0.5
ringSpan3 = perimR + spanR * 0.85
shockOuter = perimR + spanR
shockPlot = shockOuter + discAngleMod * 0.01
flowPlot = flow_psi + discAngleMod * 0.005

var discAngle = 0.0
var ringPos = 0.0

if overState {
    ringPos := ringPos[1] + ring_expansion_rate
} else {
    ringPos := 0.0
}

if overState {
    discAngle := discAngle[1]
} else {
    discAngle := discAngle[1] + spin_factor * flow_psi
}

lockedAngle = discAngle - floor(discAngle / 360.0) * 360.0
r1raw = perimR + (ringPos - floor(ringPos / spanR) * spanR)
r2off = ringPos + spanR / 3.0
r2mod = r2off - floor(r2off / spanR) * spanR
r2raw = perimR + r2mod
r3off = ringPos + spanR * 2.0 / 3.0
r3mod = r3off - floor(r3off / spanR) * spanR
r3raw = perimR + r3mod
ringR1 = r1raw * 0.28 + 0.2
ringR2 = r2raw * 0.28 + 0.2
ringR3 = r3raw * 0.28 + 0.2

overTrig = overState and not overState[1]
clearTrig = not overState and overState[1]

if overTrig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Overpressure", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Overpressure", "conedown", "#ff4477", 1.0 * markerSize, 0, "separate")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Ring1", "torus", "#ffaa00", 1.0 * markerSize, 1, "separate", 90, lockedAngle, 0)
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Ring2", "torus", "#ff5500", 1.8 * markerSize, 2, "separate", 90, lockedAngle, 0)
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Ring3", "torus", "#ff2266", 2.6 * markerSize, 3, "separate", 90, lockedAngle, 0)
    label3d(bar_index, high, "OVERPRESSURE", "#ff4477", 1, 4, "separate")
    model.entry("short", "Overpressure", 1)
}

if clearTrig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Pressure Clear", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Pressure Clear", "coneup", "#22cc88", 1.0 * markerSize, 0, "separate")
    model.exit("Overpressure")
}
